summary: Master Smart Home Technology with our training course designed for property managers. Improve efficiency and tenant experience in your properties today.
lede: Smart home technology for property managers provides a structured way to use connected devices, automation platforms, and integration workflows across managed residential properties. This course covers ecosystem evaluation, compatibility planning, access control, tenant onboarding, privacy-aware decisions, and support processes designed to improve issue detection, maintenance response, and tenant satisfaction. You will practice creating deployment and integration plans, assessing risks such as connectivity and vendor lock-in, and documenting a practical operating model. Property-based exercises address real delivery constraints, including budgets, mixed building vintages, inconsistent connectivity, and limited tenant support capacity, while introducing platforms and patterns such as Matter, Zigbee, Z-Wave, cloud dashboards, automated alerts, and AI-assisted home control.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for property professionals who need to evaluate, coordinate, and support smart home technology in managed buildings.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: You should have basic familiarity with property operations, tenant communication, and building maintenance workflows. No coding or programming is required, and no prior smart home certification is assumed. For the most practical learning experience, bring a laptop and, if available, example property asset lists, maintenance logs, or current technology policies. Participant level: Foundation to intermediate. Advanced engineering of building automation systems is not the focus; the course stays at operational application level, with hands-on planning, evaluation, and rollout design.
